facts.fact: AfDB communique says 935 km of terrestrial and under-river fibre were installed and made operational, as the first sections of the national backbone, along the Bangui-Douala road corridor (Bossembele, Yaloke, Baoro) to Berberati, with branches to Cameroon (Gamboula) and Congo (Bomassa); inaugurated 6 Feb 2023.
